name: vital-expert
description: Vital.Expert plugins for Cowork. Digital Health: five merged packs (regulatory and quality, access and value, clinical development, go-to-market, patient and user experience), plus vital-trusted, vital-verify, and navigator-ai-investment.

plugins.name: vital-trusted
plugins.description: Nineteen foundational skills for daily life-sciences work on any AI host. Checks against TRUSTED. Prove skills use the VITAL Verify connector (mcp.vital.expert/api/mcp/verify) when a vvfy_ key is present.

plugins.name: vital-verify
plugins.description: Seven skills that check a draft against the pages and papers you supply. Tools run on the VITAL Verify connector.

plugins.name: navigator-ai-investment
plugins.description: Facilitated AI investment decisions on the VITAL Ontology Navigator. Tools run on the Ontology Navigator connector (vont_ key).
